description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_Lexer class, which provides methods for lexing HTML/SGML markup into tokens, handling entities, and normalizing HTML content. It includes static factory method for creating lexer instances and utility functions for processing HTML strings.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer
classes.description: A forgiving lexer for SGML/HTML markup that converts markup into tokens, handles entities, and normalizes HTML content.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate and return a lexer object based on configuration or environment detection.

methods.name: parseData
methods.description: Parses special HTML entities in a string into their corresponding characters.

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Abstract method intended to lex HTML into tokens; triggers an error if called directly.

methods.name: escapeCDATA
methods.description: Converts CDATA sections into escaped form.

methods.name: escapeCommentedCDATA
methods.description: Converts convoluted CDATA sections for <script> tags into escaped form.

methods.name: CDATACallback
methods.description: Callback for processing CDATA sections, converting them to HTML entities.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes HTML content by converting newlines, escaping CDATA, extracting body, expanding entities, and cleaning UTF-8.

methods.name: extractBody
methods.description: Extracts the content within the <body> tag from HTML.
